title: Tunnel and Proxy Configuration Quick Reference
detail:
chisel (fastest): server chisel server -p 8000 --reverse; client ./chisel client MY:8000 R:socks
frp: TCP forwarding or stcp; remember to set [common] token; socks5 plugin [plugin socks5]
ssh trio: -D dynamic SOCKS / -L local forwarding / -R reverse forwarding (when the pivot only has outbound access)
proxychains4: socks5 127.0.0.1 1080; quiet_mode; prefix tools consistently with proxychains4
HTTP proxy: gost -L=:8080; reGeorg/Neo-reGeorg tunnels through a web shell
DNS tunnel: dnscat2 (only when only DNS can reach out)
Pitfalls: UDP does not go through SOCKS5 (nmap -sU is directly limited); specify curl --socks5 explicitly; clock skew can cause TLS failures.
